explication: TurboFieldfare is a Swift/Metal Gemma 4 inference suite: a native Mac app, CLI, loopback OpenAI-compatible server, decode service, runtime library, and streaming installer. The main workflow is to install and verify a .gturbo model, load it, submit a prompt, and stream generated output; an optional companion vision pack enables image prompts. The graph preserves those products and the runtime’s model, generation, and vision responsibilities. Relationships are limited to README statements and source-index references; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
